entries.zh: 看山人：为丧家相看坟地、择定葬处的风水先生（原书注称其为「巫师」）
entries.en: geomancer who divines grave sites; siting master for burials (the source calls them sorcerers)

entries.zh: 八月；原书以农历七月对译西历八月
entries.en: August; the seventh lunar month (used here to gloss August)
entries.notes: 以农历七月对译西历八月，系当时中西历对照的用法，非月序等同。

entries.zh: 中（意），合人心意；使人满意
entries.en: to please; to be to someone's liking
to be to one's liking; to be pleased with

entries.zh: 中主意，称心如意；合乎自己的心意
entries.en: to suit one's wishes; to be agreeable to one's mind
to please; to be agreeable (variant wording of the same phrase)

entries.zh: 报答，回报；酬答恩惠（原书注：即偿付、报偿）
entries.en: to repay, to requite; to return a benefit
to requite; to give thanks for kindness
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「報供」，与音写 pò ý、官话对音 pōu yǐ 不合，二者均指向「報意」，据音释义。

entries.en: to repay a benefit; to return a kindness

entries.zh: 报义，以情义相报；报答恩义
entries.en: to requite kindness; to repay a favour out of a sense of duty

entries.zh: 报恩义，报答恩情与情义
entries.en: to repay both benefit and kindness
to repay kindness and virtue; to be grateful for a benefit
entries.notes: 汉字栏作「報恩豪」，而音写 têg、官话对音 tē 与相邻「報恩義」「報恩德」诸条均指向「德」，故按「報恩德」释义。

entries.zh: 报恩德，报答别人的恩惠
entries.en: to repay a benefit; to be grateful for kindness received
entries.notes: 官话对音栏作 iēn guī xīn（读作「恩義人」），与本条汉字、音写不合，疑栏位错位，释义从汉字与音写。

entries.zh: 有义人：知恩重义的人；感恩之人
entries.en: a grateful man; a person of righteousness who acknowledges favours
entries.notes: 官话对音栏作 iěn guī xīn（读作「恩義人」），与汉字「有義人」及音写不合，释义从汉字与音写。

entries.zh: 承惠：接受馈赠并致谢；多谢厚赠
entries.en: to accept a gift with thanks; to be favoured with a present
to receive a favour with gratitude

entries.zh: 仁义；知恩图报之心（原书以此对译「感谢／感激之情」）
entries.notes: 「仁義」本为道德总称，与 agradecimiento 对应偏宽，释义兼顾原书对译意图。

entries.zh: 人情：恩惠、情分；受人恩惠而怀感激
entries.en: a favour; the obligation of gratitude (lit. human feeling)

entries.zh: 认恩人：记识恩主、知恩图报的人
entries.en: one who acknowledges his benefactor; a grateful person
